description.value: The study examined CSF biomarkers in FTD-related disorders, Alzheimer's disease, and healthy seniors, and validated CSF total tau observations by correlating tau levels with cortical atrophy measured using voxel-based morphometry.

clinical_characteristics.value: The phenotype was further characterized into social/executive, nonfluent progressive aphasia, fluent progressive aphasia/semantic dementia, and corticobasal degeneration subgroups.

spans.text: The phenotype was further characterized using a consensus mechanism to divide patients into four clinical subgroups: (1) a disorder of social comportment, personality, and executive functioning (SOC/EXEC); (2) a nonfluent form of progressive aphasia (PNFA) associated with effortful speech and dysarthria; (3) a fluent form of progressive aphasia, also known as semantic dementia (SD), that results in profound anomia and impaired word/object comprehension; and (4) a disorder of visual perceptual-spatial, apractic, or extrapyramidal (rigidity, myoclonus, or dystonia without tremor) functioning with the clinical diagnosis of CBD.
